The new expiry is 2027-06-30. All other terms are unchanged.
Atlas contract AT-62 current expiry: 2027-06-30, following the signed renewal.

args.uncertainty: None - all three documents directly state the expiry dates and the renewal's superseding effect. The status/current.txt confirms the renewal has been applied.
